facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Economy launched digital payment in the TaxiGab network on 28 February 2026 under the Madigipaie programme, so riders pay by mobile money or bank app.
Through the interoperable GIMAC QR codes deployed for Madigipaie, TaxiGab users can pay by mobile money or banking app whatever their financial institution, per the ministry.

GAB.note: Public services named only as a planned extension.
